in_marathi.name: Kannan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of love and mischief
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kannan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kannan is a popular name derived from the Tamil language. It is the name of Lord Murugan or Kartikeya, the god of love, war, and mischief in Hindu mythology. Kannan represents courage, leadership, and a playful spirit. The name is associated with victory, strength, and blessings.
